inputs.weather_convention: daily row D: tmin = night ending on the morning of D; wind_kmh used as night wind (approximation, no hourly in prototype)

synthetic_inputs.why: Prototype has no cloud cover, topo class or cover inventory. Values follow DATA-NOTES: 'clear, calm nights 14–19 Nov; cold air pools on the plain; Geraneia above the inversion; Pachi mild (sea)'.

source_text.title: Frost at leaf level on the low plain, night Wed 18 → Thu 19 Nov
source_text.body: Clear, calm nights Tue-Thu. Cold air drains off Geraneia and pools on the plain: 2 m air min 0.5 °C at Μεσαίο Χωράφι, 0.0 °C at Κάτω Κάμπος, 0.2 °C at Νότιος Κάμπος. Leaf surfaces can be 2-3 °C colder than the air. Young coriander and dill (Μεσαίο Χωράφι) are the most exposed. Geraneia Slope is warmer (4.0 °C, above the cold layer) and Pachi (5.0 °C, sea).
source_text.action: Wed 18 Nov before sunset: cover coriander + dill (Μεσαίο Χωράφι) with 17-19 g/m² fleece (gains ~1-2 °C). Remove Thu 19 after ~10:00 when thawed, before the windy front on Fri. Thu 19: no harvest of spinach (Κάτω Κάμπος) or chicory before leaves thaw (~10:00).
source_text.why_rule: Warn when forecast 2 m min <= 2 °C AND night wind <= 5 km/h AND clear sky on parcels below 50 m. Leaf surface can be 2-3 °C below air on such nights. Damage temperature for each crop is NOT set by the app – your agronomist can set it.

notes: Same facts as A01 (P1 only), but the rule's [SET] values are not approved.
